purpose: T91: cross-scale unified Track B signal benchmark — replays the frozen T82 daily contract unchanged (v1 cohort pinned, 5d continuous label, frozen test folds, trailing-180 PIT, 5bps+funding cost, 10 cells) AND adds an intraday layer over the hourly cohort (trailing-90-record PIT, 4h forward mark bps label, 7 cells), plus a cross_scale replication block on funding_pct. Placebo controls, determinism double-run, PASS/ECON_ONLY/FAIL verdicts.
daily_contract: identical to research/financial_signal_benchmark_protocol_v1.json (imported from scripts/financial_signal_benchmark_v1.py, not re-implemented)

intraday_contract.label: label.forward_return_bps — 4h forward mark move, bps (gross)
intraday_contract.pit: trailing-90-record mid-rank percentiles, per-asset, window excludes current record
intraday_contract.cost: 5bps taker/side + funding accrual when ns_until_next_funding_settlement falls inside the 4h hold
intraday_contract.folds: 3 contiguous equal-width ns windows over the eval span (no frozen validator folds exist at this scale)

metrics_per_cell: Spearman rho/t/p + Welch top-vs-bottom quintile + top-decile arm net stats + placebo rhos + verdict — same shape at both scales
cross_scale: daily vs hourly funding_pct rho/p/sign; replication flag: replicated_both_scales | directional_only | not_replicated
fdr_families: TWO separate BH-FDR families (alpha=0.05): 10 daily cells and 7 intraday cells — no cross-scale pooling
verdict_rules: PASS = FDR-survive AND |rho|>placebo band; ECON_ONLY = beats always-long net but not FDR; else FAIL (same rule at both scales)
